templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from mirrored-pair by the note-writer: three side-by-side CVM boxes (CVM1, CVM2, CVM3) roll up into one Server table below, a three-member replicated-grid aggregation, not two peers mirrored around a shared middle.
templates.what_to_learn: The transferable move is replicated-grid's: draw the same guaranteed-versus-oversubscribed split bar on every member, call out just one member's split in detail, then roll all members into one aggregate table below with the shared, scarce resource highlighted in its own colour, yellow for the oversubscribed pool here.
